thread:
Rosa Nguyen: FYI onboarding batch jobs that wrote embeddings between 02:1002:55 UTC show partial writes and lower similarity scores in search. Not widespread but affects some trial accounts. Need a short customer status + office hours invite and a renewal-risk note for CSMs.
Priya Desai: I can take the status draft. Can someone confirm how many tenants and which tiers?
Ethan Moore: Quick query: 22 tenants with write errors, 7 flagged as high-touch (paid trials / enterprise evals). Most errors were timeouts from our ingest service returning 504.
Carlos Vega: Root cause summary: a TTL regression in the embeddings-router connection pool caused occasional upstream disconnects under burst traffic. We pushed a fix (pool TTL extended) at 03:05 UTC; retry logic recovered many writes but a subset of jobs never retried.
Rosa Nguyen: Thanks Carlos. Priya, aim for short note plus a line about re-ingest guidance and a link to office hours at 16:00 UTC. Also include incident ticket.
Priya Desai: Draft copy below:
---- customer copy start ----
Hello 0 we detected an issue affecting some recently uploaded embeddings between 02:10 and 03:05 UTC. We resolved the underlying router connection issue and most services are healthy. If you observed failed uploads, incomplete search results, or lower match quality, please reply or join our office hours at 16:00 UTC (eng on the call).

We logged this as INC-2026-3410. Track updates at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-3410. Your CSM will follow up about any necessary re-ingest steps and remediation credits.
---- customer copy end ----n
Ethan Moore: Add a short FAQ bullet: "Do I need to re-ingest?" Answer: "Only for items marked failed in your job report; we'll attach a CSV with keys to re-send." Also suggested we offer to waive overage charges for any re-ingest traffic caused by this incident.
Carlos Vega: Confirming: ~9% of ingest traffic hit the faulty path at peak. No model weights were changed; this is an operational reliability issue only. We'll include a timeline in the RCA.
Amir Khan: I'll prepare the failed-job CSV and annotate which batches fully succeeded vs partially failed. ETA: 11:30 UTC.
Rosa Nguyen: Good. Priya, please send high-touch messages first and include the CSV when Amir posts it. Also coordinate renewal-risk flags: if renewal in 60 days and affected, escalate to renewals@.
Priya Desai: Will do. Office hours scheduled (16:00 UTC) 0 eng leads: Carlos + Ethan. Short notes doc link: https://docs.redwood.ai/incident-notes/INC-2026-3410 (private).
Ethan Moore: Immediate mitigation we did: extended router pool TTL, tightened idle-connection handling, and added a retry window to ingest job controller to ensure one more attempt for transient 5xx/504 errors. Long-term: host-level health checks and playback tests before router rollouts.
Rosa Nguyen: For CSMs: suggested renewal script snippet: "If affected and renewal within 60 days, offer to review credits and provide 30 days of elevated support at no extra cost." Keep it short and ask customers to flag renewals in their reply.
Carlos Vega: RCA ETA EOD. For now status set to monitoring.
Priya Desai: Sending high-touch batch now (7 tenants). Paste: "High-touch outreach (7) sent at 10:22 UTC 0 awaiting replies."
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3410 status changed to "monitoring". Next scheduled update: 17:00 UTC.
Rosa Nguyen: Thanks team. After office hours we'll consolidate asks and finalize the EOD RCA + customer follow-up template. Assigning: Priya 0 outbound comms; Amir 0 failed-job CSV; Carlos 0 RCA write; Ethan 0 mitigation summary; Rosa 0 exec note and renewal escalation.
Priya Desai: Quick reminder to CSMs in the thread: keep replies concise and add the incident ID in all communications.
Amir Khan: CSV posted to internal folder and linked in the office hours doc. Noting 3 tenants had intermittent success on smaller batches; will flag partials.
Ethan Moore: If any customer replies claim data loss, escalate to eng-oncall and place a hold on automated retry deletion until we validate.
Rosa Nguyen: Good point. Minimal replies from here on to keep the thread tidy per CS process.
